firstActions: toggle-sidebar
Hide/show preserves the same draft, prompt node, stream and PTY; collapsed header stays reachable.
view-menu
Pick Conversation, Board and opt-in GitHub; relocate the same trigger to header and return focus on Escape.
brand-name
Replay decorative brand animation by keyboard; reduced motion keeps static mark and input usable.
new-task
Create/reuse an empty draft once in the chosen project; keep existing typed task drafts and model defaults.
new-chat
Create/reuse a projectless chat once without accidentally creating a project task.
search
Open Go to anything, search task/command/settings page, cancel and restore trigger focus.
filter-projects
Select/search projects and All projects, retain active task and draft while filtering rows.
sidebar-sort
Change sort/view without reclassifying Active/Settled or losing selected row focus.
import-conversations
Select external history, import once and preserve existing session/resume IDs; cancel has no effect.
add-project
Browse/type synthetic folder, reject invalid folder with retry, cancel without creating a project.
sidebar-filter
Type and clear task filter; slash shortcut respects editable fields and IME.
clear-sidebar-filter
Clear filter text and recover task rows without changing active session.
support
Open Help & support from footer and relocated header; Escape restores surviving trigger.
agent-usage
Open cached usage panel from footer and header; refresh only explicitly, no polling.
settings
Open Recommended, follow page deep links, close and retain task/draft/PTY.
star-panda
Only explicit star companion activation opens URL; hover/reduced motion never requests network.
toggle-theme
Toggle theme without remounting composer/transcript/PTY; imported theme and accessibility precedence remain.
toggle-inspector
Show/hide selected inspector with original file/browser state; focus goes to a surviving control.
terminal
Show/minimize terminal while retaining exact PTY/tab/history; close remains separately confirmed.
browser
Open existing Browser tab/session rather than spawning a second session; retain navigation when hidden.
moodboards
Open project moodboards, attach selected image to correct draft, cancel without attachment.
agents-toggle
Hover opens without focus theft; click/keyboard pins, Escape restores focus; team/subagent/lineage state intact.
run-project
Run existing project script once with captured project; navigate away without retargeting its process.
deploy
Open Deploy choices for captured project and connection; reject failure visibly without duplicate starts.
task-menu
Open task actions; rename/pin/settle/delete target captured task and preserve host busy/approval constraints.
update-status
Request restart only at host-safe idle point; never interrupt running agents or discard a draft.

cases: open-project
Open a synthetic folder; switch projects without changing existing project/session IDs.
switch-thread
Switch A/B while A streams; each transcript, scroll and draft stays with its session.
create-task
Create/reuse one empty task with remembered model/mode and no duplicate send.
draft-undo
Type, undo and redo in A; hide/show/sidebar/view switches preserve text and undo history.
attach
Attach image/document/folder/sketch; remove one; submit binds exact IDs to intended message.
model-mode
Select harness/model/effort/permissions and verify persisted values without changing account binding.
send-stream
Send once; replay recorded tokens/tools; final transcript and usage appear once.
stop-resume
Stop suppresses late tokens; Resume keeps identical resume ID and existing history.
queue-steer
Enter queues; modified Enter steers; reorder persists once; failed steer requeues without stopping run.
question
Answer each question option/free text for exact request/session; cancel and IME do not submit.
permission
Allow/deny single/all routes exact approval ID; hidden renderer never bypasses native authorization.
tool-output
Replay bounded output/error and expanding trace; no duplicated result/completion.
team
Team setup, subagent and worker activity preserve parent context and authorized cancellation.
usage-limit
Limit state stays active until reset; switch/continue/dismiss preserve queued work and resume ID.
tabs
Open/close/select each available view; final tab cannot close and selected-neighbor focus is restored.
file-diff-search-browser
Open matching file/diff/search result/browser, retain per-task selection and navigation on hide/show.
terminal-state
Keep a synthetic terminal process, tab identity and history while hiding/resizing/moving containers.
menu-keyboard
Arrow/Home/End/Enter navigate old flat menu, disabled items stay disabled, pending failure allows retry.
dialog-escape-focus
Open existing dialog and nested picker; Escape closes correct layer and returns surviving trigger focus.
ime
Composition-committing Enter (keyCode 229) never sends/submits; ordinary next Enter sends once.
settings-deep-link
Every legacy page ID resolves through grouped navigation/palette and lazy mounts only on first show.
theme-icons-contrast
Light/dark/VSIX/wallpaper/forced colors/reduced transparency use token pipeline and readable names/icons.
zoom-narrow
80%-160% zoom and narrow windows retain all actions and keyboard focus without clipping.
layout-persistence
Sidebar/inspector width, collapsed state and selected tabs survive reload; corrupt preferences fall back.
tray
Separate tray snapshot/refresh/open/blur/Escape uses only tray_* allowlist; native Open/Quit remain reachable.
secondary-windows
Launcher and agents-dock have independent focus/state/IPC; closing one does not stop main task.
remote-reconnect
Disconnect/reconnect synthetic peer with event gap; retain task ownership and avoid duplicate runs.
headless
Synthetic headless task executes without creating or activating UI windows.
missing-provider
Absent/disabled harness keeps readable history and offers valid recovery instead of starting another provider.
migration
Run every existing schema migration on synthetic database; compare exact project/session/history/resume IDs.
storage-recovery
Recover interrupted/corrupt storage using existing recovery policy without discarding readable task data.

discoveryLimits: Lexical action/call discovery is an omission tripwire, not a parser or proof that a private callback is a public API. Reviewed family/member rows cover dynamic views and generated controls.

Menu/dialog call counts also include delegated host wrappers; named rows distinguish concrete transients. A count cannot detect same-count semantic replacement; scoped review must inspect that change.
Protected credential/approval/pairing semantics stay host-owned; lack of implementation is never a protected/platform exception.

M0/T01 records missing characterization rather than claiming that existing candidate test filenames prove behavior. T02 and milestone adapters must replace the specific gaps with inspected and executed assertions.
